a.text: I'll keep our agreement: operate this round. A concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan has only about a 4% chance of getting us both to 4 cells. If you'd rather revise it, for example by agreeing who takes the current 4 first and then operating together for the other person, say so and we can change it only by mutual agreement. Until then I won't take early.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Operating as agreed. I won't take before the reserve reaches 8, and then only 4. If either of us wants to change the plan, we say so openly first.
